description: This file contains the implementation of display driver functions for the SSD1306 OLED display using I2C communication protocol within the lws (libwebsockets) framework. It includes initialization, setting contrast, blitting pixel data, and power control functions specific to the SSD1306 display driver.

methods.name: int lws_display_ssd1306_i2c_init(const struct lws_display * disp)
methods.description: Initializes the SSD1306 display over I2C, including GPIO reset sequence and sending initialization command list.

methods.name: int lws_display_ssd1306_i2c_contrast(const struct lws_display * disp,uint8_t b)
methods.description: Sets the display contrast (brightness level) of the SSD1306 over I2C.

methods.name: int lws_display_ssd1306_i2c_blit(const struct lws_display * disp,const uint8_t * src,lws_display_scalar x,lws_display_scalar y,lws_display_scalar w,lws_display_scalar h)
methods.description: Transfers pixel data to the SSD1306 display, handling address window setup and data chunk transfer.

methods.name: int lws_display_ssd1306_i2c_power(const struct lws_display * disp,int state)
methods.description: Controls the power state of the display, turning it on or off.

ctags.name: lws_display_ssd1306_i2c_blit
ctags.signature: (const struct lws_display * disp,const uint8_t * src,lws_display_scalar x,lws_display_scalar y,lws_display_scalar w,lws_display_scalar h)
